title: Quantum Subliminal Learning
summary: Machine learning models can inherit hidden behavioral traits through innocuous public interfaces, a phenomenon known as subliminal learning. Here we extend this framework to quantum models and study two distillation pathways: an auxiliary channel on random inputs and a restricted task channel in which the student matches a public supervised output while the hidden behavior resides on a disjoint task.
